北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗但体感-5℃，北风 4级，记得多穿衣物保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -5℃ with a Level 4 northerly wind. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有霾且风力 5级，体感 12℃。出门别忘戴口罩，注意添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has haze and a Level 5 wind, feels like 12℃. Don't forget your mask and add layers!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海今天有霾，体感 11℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意呼吸健康！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze today, feels like 11℃. Remember to wear a mask and protect your respiratory health!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚体感 23℃，但湿度较高，注意补水和防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 23℃, but humidity is high. Remember to hydrate and protect from sun!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳今天晴好，体感 24℃。阳光正好，出门记得做好防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 24℃ today. The sun is great, remember sun protection!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾且风力 5级，体感 8℃。注意保暖，出门记得戴口罩！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze and a Level 5 wind, feels like 8℃. Stay warm and remember your mask!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感 4℃，北风 4级有点凉，记得添衣保暖，别感冒了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels like 4℃ with a Level 4 northerly wind. It's chilly, add layers and don't catch a cold!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，外出记得带件外套哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 10℃. The temperature difference is large, bring a jacket when going out!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 6℃。风力 3级有点凉，记得戴口罩、多添衣！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze and feels like 6℃. The Level 3 wind is a bit chilly, remember your mask and add layers!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 5℃且湿度较低。记得多喝水，注意皮肤保湿哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 5℃ and humidity is low. Remember to drink more water and moisturize your skin!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾，体感 10℃。能见度低，驾车出行务必注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 10℃. Visibility is low, please drive safely if you're out and about!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，但体感-17℃！严寒袭来，务必把自己裹严实哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -17℃! Extreme cold is here, please bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗体感-9℃，北风 3级，风寒效应明显，注意保暖防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels like -9℃ with a Level 3 northerly wind. The wind chill is noticeable, stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，出门记得带件外套哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 10℃. The temperature difference is large, bring a jacket when going out!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾，能见度低。驾车出行请务必小心，注意交通安全！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, with low visibility. Please be extra careful when driving, mind traffic safety!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感-1℃，风力 5级。风大天冷，记得防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, feels like -1℃ with a Level 5 wind. It's windy and cold, remember windproof and warm clothing!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-4℃。虽然没下雪，但依然很冷，注意保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -4℃. Even without snow, it's still very cold, stay warm!
